title: Mia's Pocket Money
text:
Mia gets two pounds of pocket money every week. She gets it on Friday after school. She puts the money in a jar in her room. She wants to buy a red bicycle one day.

Her friend Sam gets more money, but he spends it at once. He buys drinks and chocolate every day. Mia thinks it is better to wait. She likes to save money for big things.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Mia get each week?
When does Mia get her pocket money?
Why does Mia put her money in a jar?
options: She wants to save for a bicycle
She wants to give it to Sam

questions.text: How does Sam probably feel when all his money is gone?
options: He probably regrets spending it all
He is happy to have no money left
He wants to buy a bicycle today

paragraph_translations: Mia dostaje dwa funty kieszonkowego każdego tygodnia. Dostaje je w piątek po szkole. Wkłada pieniądze do słoika w swoim pokoju. Pewnego dnia chce kupić czerwony rower.
Jej przyjaciel Sam dostaje więcej pieniędzy, ale od razu je wydaje. Codziennie kupuje napoje i czekoladę. Mia uważa, że lepiej jest czekać. Lubi oszczędzać pieniądze na większe rzeczy.
